verdict.rationale: YYLO is an installable CLI (npm) that runs local git worktrees, ledger, and orchestration, implying it runs on infrastructure the user controls (local machine), but the evidence pack never mentions containers, Docker, VM deployment, or any self-hosted server/service architecture beyond a local CLI tool. missing for 10: explicit container/Docker deployment docs, VM/server hosting instructions, and confirmation of a persistent self-hosted service rather than just a local CLI.
